synthesis:draft.headline: Peak RRP 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (UTC+0930)
summary: The five-minute regional reference price (RRP) peak in SA1 was 4981.0 $/MWh at 2026-07-31 02:05 ACST (UTC+0930).
Across the analysis window there were 214 five-minute intervals at or above the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh.
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-07-30 17:00 UTC / 2026-07-31 02:30 ACST) was 1466.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 2173.0 MW.

Weather-model WS50M (Adelaide point) shows low hourly wind-speed proxy values during the window (hourly WS50M minimum and maximum recorded in the context), and individual wind-unit SCADA drops were observed in the 15:00–17:00 UTC window; these are descriptive observations, not statements of cause.
No AEMO market notice specific to the SA1 event window was returned in the retrieved documents set (retrieved documents were procedures/definitions).

possible_explanations.statement: Lower regional wind availability around the peak may have contributed to reduced local supply pressure (see WS50M wind-speed proxy and individual wind-unit SCADA drops).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare aggregated semi-scheduled (wind) generation for SA1 at and around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z with typical output for that hour and with dispatch demand at 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z; obtain per-farm SCADA for major wind farms and constraint/curtailment records for the same intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: High-priced offers or rebids by scheduled generators might have set marginal price in the interval ending 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Inspect rebid and offer (BID/REBID) records for large scheduled generators in SA1 in the minutes before and during 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z and compare offered volumes and prices to dispatch targets.

possible_explanations.statement: Interconnector capability or operational constraints could have limited supply options and might be relevant to the price outcome.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check interconnector availability, flow limits and any constraint notices for the intervals around 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z, and compare actual net interchange at 2026-07-30T16:35:00Z with those capability records.
